'''Pyochayarit''' was an area in the [[Azda Cluster]] region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Satele Shan]] was commemorated by the area's [[Satele Shan Boulevard]]. During the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the publishing company [[Anooba Press]] operated from [[Suite 44800]] of the property [[830-303 Satele Shan Boulevard]] located on the street.
